# Download LinkEDA

The current public release contains LinkEDA 0.0.113 for **64 bit Windows 11**.
It is experimental software and should be used with copies of important data.

<p>Uses an existing installation of R 4.1 or newer and installs LinkEDA in that

<p><a class="button button-primary" href="https://github.com/valerop/LinkEDA/releases/download/v0.0.113R/Instalar-LinkEDA-0.0.113-Windows.exe">Download standard installer</a></p>

Both installers create a **LinkEDA** shortcut on the desktop. Neither requires
Rtools, Visual Studio or Windows Developer Mode. Internet access is required
while the required R packages are installed.

## Install and start

1. Close LinkEDA if an older version is running.
2. Double-click the downloaded installer.
3. Wait while it installs LinkEDA and the required R packages.
4. Open **LinkEDA** from the desktop shortcut.

Running the newer installer also updates an existing installation; uninstalling
the previous version is not required.

According to the Windows security configuration, the first run may show a
reputation warning because this experimental build is not code signed. Check
that the filename and SHA-256 value match this page before running it.

## Start with data

The Welcome window can import a supported data file or open an example. Users
of the standard edition can also start from an R data frame:

```r
library(LinkEDA)
LinkEDA(mtcars)
```

The complete edition runs its own private R session behind the desktop
application.

## macOS

The macOS application is being synchronized with the same LinkEDA 0.0.113
source release. A current macOS binary is not included in v0.0.113R. The
repository contains the source and a detailed macOS continuation document for
building and validating the matching native application.

## Report a problem

Include the public release tag (`v0.0.113R`), the LinkEDA version shown by the
application (`0.0.113`), Windows version, installer edition and the steps that
triggered the problem. Unexpected native interface errors are recorded in
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\LinkEDA\logs\LinkEDA.log`.
